title: Report/figure rendering hardening (DB-277/DB-278): layout._css_string also neutralizes angle brackets so a run-identity value containing </style> cannot break out of the @page <style> block; formatting._as_float returns None for inf/nan so format_int_commas/format_ratio/format_sqft/format_feet/whole_percent_shares degrade a non-finite document value to 'missing' instead of crashing or printing 'inf.0'; kit/labels.format_number fails closed on a non-numeric or non-finite value (which also fixes close_frame_dimensions._fact_figure via format_number, WITHOUT editing the NB-04-pinned close_frame module). Byte-identical on every valid document.
objective: Three smallest-safe guards, each byte-identical on valid documents and each proven by one test per input state plus a mutation revert. (1) services/api/app/drawings/report/layout.py::_css_string (lines 29-38): in addition to the existing backslash/double-quote/newline escapes, neutralize '<' and '>' as CSS hex escapes ('<'->'\3C ', '>'->'\3E ') so a header/footer value containing '</style>' cannot terminate the <style> element the @page margin boxes live in; '\3C ' renders as '<' in the content string, so any value WITHOUT angle brackets (every run-identity value: address, 'Results revision N', 'computed YYYY-MM-DD') produces byte-identical CSS. (2) services/api/app/drawings/report/formatting.py::_as_float (lines 22-30): add 'import math' and 'return None' when the float is not math.isfinite; this single change makes format_int_commas (no OverflowError/ValueError), format_ratio (no 'inf.0'/'nan.0'), format_sqft, format_feet and whole_percent_shares (no int(inf) crash) all treat inf/nan as a missing value, never 0. (3) services/api/app/drawings/kit/labels.py::format_number (lines 31-33): guard 'if isinstance(value,bool) or not isinstance(value,(int,float)) or not math.isfinite(value): raise ValueError(...)' (math already imported) so a non-numeric value no longer raises the cryptic "Unknown format code 'f'" and a non-finite value no longer renders literal 'inf sq ft'; this fix also covers close_frame_dimensions._fact_figure (which formats via format_number) with no edit to the NB-04-pinned maps module. No engine, schema, fixture, snapshot, maps or close-frame change.
business_reason: return-T169-G5 (F1: </style> breakout in layout._css_string now also carrying run-identity values; F2: inf/nan crash/garbage in figure formatting) and return-T188-G5 (advisory: format_number/_fact_figure accept non-numeric/non-finite). All three are latent fail-open/crash sinks that the gates flagged as ADVISORY on the feature tasks; this task closes them under the project's fail-closed discipline without moving any benchmark output.

acceptance_scenarios.then: the output contains NO '</style>' substring and shows the CSS hex escape '\3C '; mutation: removing the '<' replace in _css_string makes raw '</style>' reappear

acceptance_scenarios.given: a normal header 'Results revision 3' and footer value with no angle brackets
acceptance_scenarios.then: the stylesheet string is byte-identical to the pre-change output (the two new replaces are a no-op)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a finite document value (int and fractional float)
a non-finite document value float('inf') and float('nan')
acceptance_scenarios.then: each returns None (value shown as missing); mutation: removing the math.isfinite guard makes format_int_commas(inf) raise OverflowError and format_ratio(inf)=='inf.0'
it returns None; mutation: without the guard it raises on int(nan)

acceptance_scenarios.given: kit format_number with a finite real (incl. -0.0 and a thousands value)
acceptance_scenarios.then: output is byte-identical ('-0'/''->'0'); every existing kit/maps/cad caller is unaffected

acceptance_scenarios.then: each raises ValueError (fails closed); mutation: without the guard inf renders 'inf' and 'abc' raises the cryptic format-code error; close_frame._fact_figure inherits the fix with no edit to close_frame_dimensions.py

acceptance_scenarios.then: test_report_benchmark.py (report HTML snapshot), the DXF and site_plan.svg snapshots, tests/drawings/kit and tests/drawings/maps all stay GREEN with no snapshot file edited — the byte-identity proof that no valid output moved

acceptance_scenarios.given: a report whose run identity carries a full 40-character code commit (the route's identity commit, or GIT_COMMIT_SHA / RENDER_GIT_COMMIT set in the process, as production sets it)
acceptance_scenarios.when: the report is printed (TestClient POST /report with the benchmark providers and the commit set, then apps/web/scripts/print-report-pdf.mjs)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the long commit wraps inside its appendix column (a print-stylesheet rule in layout.py lets an evidence-column list item break anywhere); the benchmark prints on the same 10 pages, at the same scale, as with the commit unknown (page-by-page text identical except the commit line); a test pins the rule; mutation: without the rule the same print shrinks to 8 pages

risks: RISK 1 (dispositive): close_frame_dimensions.py is NB-04-pinned (code_identity) and owned by spec-M5-T172. Item 3 MUST be done in kit/labels.format_number only; editing close_frame_dimensions.py would fire the NB-04 contingency and collide with M5-T172. If a typed DimensionPlacementError at the close-frame seam is later wanted, that is a separate task sequenced out of parallel with M5-T172 (owns NB-04).

RISK 2 (byte-identity): the proof relies on T172/T169-owned snapshot tests (test_report_benchmark.py, the DXF/SVG snapshots) staying green; they are FORBIDDEN here and must not be edited. Run them read-only; any red means a valid output moved and is a real defect, not a snapshot refresh.

RISK 3 (scope): out-of-regime hardening only; no feature behaviour, no new figure, no engine/schema/fixture change. kit format_number raising ValueError is the fail-closed choice; it is not DimensionPlacementError (that would require the forbidden close_frame edit).
